# MODEL: Agent 2 must keep one capacity for its whole strategy

# PURPOSE: Separates two readings of a coalition strategy. Agent 1 sends the
# play to sL or sR. In sL agent 2 reaches goal only with A (capacity cap), in
# sR only with B (capacity cop); D belongs to both capacities.

# LOGIC: CAPATL

# DESCRIPTION: <{2}>F goal and <{2}>(!lost U goal) are False at s0: with cap
# agent 2 ends in bad (labelled lost) from sR, with cop from sL. A strategy that could pick its capacity per branch
# (play D at s0, then A in sL and B in sR) would win.
